method: Pure v4 full-path coverage repair: natural56 unique without replacement over all23503faces, plus4disgust/2angry/2sad TRAIN-only cycling extras each batch. Unit CE, no label smoothing, SupCon or RDrop. Original dropout.35; oldBNstats fixed. 50%raw/50%mild brightness-contrast jitter. No affine or horizontalflip.
selection: Validation accuracy, macroF1 and disgustF1 strictly improve over baseline; disgustrecall increases at least8percentagepoints (28%to36%minimum). Max .4accuracy+.4macroF1+.2disgustF1, student or averaged-weight single network. Maxonefrozen testcandidate after training.
deployment: Keep app/PPT unchanged unless the frozen pure candidate improves full same-set testaccuracy,macroF1,disgustF1 and improves disgustrecall at least5percentagepoints over baseline36.71%. No alternate testsearch. All seven test metrics and regressions reported.
inference: One pure FusDenseNet network, single view, validation temperature only, no inference offsets/thresholds/hybrid/teacher/externalencoder.
limits: Training-only six-batch gradient and perturbation diagnostics are exploratory; changes are not an isolated controlled ablation. Reused validation and historically inspected test are not fresh identity-disjoint confirmation. No orientation robustness,80%accuracy or clinical efficacy claim.
